summary: Linked-list node follower: reads the object pointer stored at offset 0x1C, copies it into offset 0x24, then dereferences it and returns its first DWORD when non-null, otherwise returns 0. Used by RenderDispatchWithIteration (004993D0) as part of iterating a list. The ABI lead names it LinkedList_Follow_0x1c_Pointer.

local_names.this: iterator/list container: base object pointer at +0x0
local_names.v2: pointer value at obj+0x1C, copied to obj+0x24 and dereferenced

operations.description: Read the base object pointer from *this (offset 0x0) into v1
Copy the source pointer field at obj+0x1C into the destination field at obj+0x24

If the copied pointer is non-null, return the first DWORD of the pointed-to object (field at *(obj+0x1C)+0); otherwise return 0. Sole caller is RenderDispatchWithIteration (004993D0); ABI lead labels it LinkedList_Follow_0x1c_Pointer

unresolved: The exact nature of the pointer at obj+0x1C and the field at obj+0x24 (whether a shared object pointer or a list head) is not established; the packet only shows the copy and first-DWORD return
